answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 12678 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to eat at a table? Question: Is it permissible to eat at a table? Answer ID: 12678 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 775/726=B/1430) It is allowable, but against sunnah. The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) used to eat at a piece of cloth or leather on ground. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
